name: J. A. McGregor
role: Rancher down the river (B—T ranch); collector of petrified wood
bio: J. A. "Jack" McGregor ranched down the Little Missouri, and in fall 1884 he gave the Cow Boy a prized piece of petrified wood and brought in a load of petrifactions for the New Orleans exposition. He and his wife came to town often, and in July 1885 they moved their household to the Cantonment for the summer. His ranch hosted hunters such as E. Kessler of New York in 1885, and he joined hunting parties that brought back deer, prairie chickens and, in late 1886, dozens of antelope. In October 1886 the paper identified him as "of the B—T ranch."
